XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Motorised throttle body

  • Fault: During heavy acceleration, the vehicle experiences significant power loss, the spanner warning light illuminates and there are sporadic misfires.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P2112 (Throttle actuator control system – Incorrect position/closed)

  • Cause: Faulty motorised throttle body

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the throttle body and, if necessary, clean or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: In this case, the component showed no visual faults. After replacement, reprogramming using diagnostic equipment is not required. The estimated time for the procedure is approximately 0.50 hours.
